C269.label: Cayman Islands · 1990 · 1 Cent
C269.notes: SER NA-KY-005. Obverse photo confirmed (portrait white 2×2) · legend CAYMAN ISLANDS · ELIZABETH II · crowned Maklouf 3rd portrait · date 1990 clearly below — matches the 1987–1990 bronze KM#87 type (not the later copper-plated steel KM#87a from 1992). Reverse not photographed; denomination user-confirmed (Joseph: copper color matched 1 Cent · confirmed “1”). Expected bird is the Grand Cayman thrush (Turdus ravidus, extinct) — not a Caribbean grackle. First Cayman 1 Cent in the vault; siblings are all 5¢: C185/C214 / NA-KY-001/002 (1996) · C186 / NA-KY-003 (2002) · C215 / NA-KY-004 (2008). SER assigned next-free NA-KY-005 (do not renumber existing); eventual year→denom geo sort would place this first before the 1996+ 5¢ ladder. Tourist soda / ferry / market odd-cent while bronze still jingled on the Islands. Cayman flips now 5.
C269.story: A 1990 1 cent from Cayman Islands. The obverse shows Raphael Maklouf crowned Elizabeth II right; the reverse shows (not photographed) Grand Cayman thrush (Turdus ravidus, extinct) beside 1, engraver SD (Stuart Devlin); legend CAYMAN ISLANDS, ELIZABETH II and date 1990 below are on the obverse. Struck in bronze.
